lines.zh: 苹果蠹蛾在夜里飞过枝头
lines.en: The codling moth flies the branches at night.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍得很快很碎
lines.en: Its wings beat fast and choppy.
It loops around the tree crown.
It climbs close along the bark.
Its path rises and dips.

lines.zh: 它被灯的光引偏了方向
lines.en: A lamp pulls it off course.
It settles on a leaf and stops.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀摊平，像块木屑
lines.en: Its wings flatten like a wood chip.
It sideslips past the leaf edge.
It steers around a strand of web.
It flies low, brushing the grass tips.
It flies from dark toward darker.
Its shadow falls on the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 它振翅的声音细得几乎听不见
lines.en: Its wingbeat is nearly inaudible.

lines.zh: 它绕着树干飞了一整圈
lines.en: It circles the trunk entirely.

lines.zh: 它忽然改变高度，向上窜
lines.en: It suddenly changes height and climbs.
The moth rests with wings closed.

lines.zh: 它的翅面像一小片树皮
lines.en: Its wings look like a scrap of bark.
Its antennae swing slowly.
Its wingtips twitch.

lines.zh: 它把身体压低贴住叶面
lines.en: It presses flat to the leaf.
It is livelier at night.
Its eyes stay open; it is not asleep.

lines.zh: 它的翅纹在光下很难看清
lines.en: Its pattern is hard to read in the light.

lines.zh: 它缓缓张开翅，抖了一下
lines.en: It opens its wings and shivers once.

lines.zh: 它把翅收回去，盖住身体
lines.en: It folds them back over itself.

lines.zh: 它像长在叶子上的一块斑
lines.en: It looks like a blotch grown on the leaf.

lines.zh: 它移到叶片更暗的一侧
lines.en: It moves to the darker side of the leaf.

lines.zh: 一根触角碰到叶脉就缩回
lines.en: An antenna meets a vein and recoils.
It waits quietly for deeper night.
The moth rests, wings facing you.

lines.zh: 它的触角朝你的方向弯
lines.en: Its antennae bend your way.

lines.zh: 它一动不动，像一片枯叶
lines.en: It holds still as a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 你靠近，它的翅抽了一下
lines.en: You near it; a wing twitches.

lines.zh: 它忽然起飞，绕了个圈又落下
lines.en: It flutters up, circles, and lands.

lines.zh: 它落在你袖子上，收起翅
lines.en: It lands on your sleeve and folds up.

lines.zh: 它在你手臂上走了两步
lines.en: It takes two steps on your arm.

lines.zh: 它的足轻得像没有重量
lines.en: Its feet are nearly weightless.

lines.zh: 它对你的气味很有兴趣
lines.en: Your scent interests it.
It lifts off and lands elsewhere.
The moth is knocked into a crooked flight.
It sheds a patch of wing dust.
It lands with a wing askew.
It struggles back into the air.
Its wingbeats lose their rhythm.
It retreats into a bark crevice.
It folds its wings in tight.
Its antennae droop.

lines.zh: 它飞得很低，绕不开障碍
lines.en: It flies low and keeps hitting things.

lines.zh: 它还是朝有光的地方去
lines.en: It still heads for the light.
The moth is drawn by something sweet.
It circles the scent.
It lands and probes with antennae.
It unrolls its long proboscis.
It stays and feeds a long while.

lines.zh: 它对你手里的果子很感兴趣
lines.en: The fruit in your hand draws it.
It walks slowly over the skin.
Finished, it wipes its proboscis.
It flies one more lap around you.

lines.zh: 它落在同一个位置不肯走
lines.en: It returns to the same spot and stays.
The moth bumps your face, barely.
The breeze tumbles it over.
It recovers and flies up again.

lines.zh: 它的翅粉沾在你手背上
lines.en: Wing dust smudges your hand.

lines.zh: 它落在你肩上又立刻飞走
lines.en: It lands on your shoulder and leaves at once.

lines.zh: 它绕开你的手，改了个方向
lines.en: It swerves around your hand.

lines.zh: 它的翅尖刮过你的耳朵
lines.en: A wingtip brushes your ear.
The knock carries it off a few blocks.
It hovers a moment before leaving.
It reads your movement as wind.
Two moths circle each other in flight.

lines.zh: 它们飞成一个歪斜的圈
lines.en: Their circle comes out lopsided.

lines.zh: 一只落下，另一只跟着落
lines.en: One lands; the other follows.
Their antennae almost touch.
Their wings quiver together.

lines.zh: 它们在叶背上一动不动
lines.en: They hold still on the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 两只的影子合成一小块暗
lines.en: Their shadows make one small dark spot.
Each shakes out its wings.

lines.zh: 然后它们分开，各飞一边
lines.en: Then they part, each its own way.
That passage of the night is brief.

lines.zh: 蠹蛾落在果子上，伸出喙
lines.en: The moth lands on the fruit and unrolls its beak.
Its proboscis probes into a split.
Its abdomen swells slightly.

lines.zh: 它对不甜的东西不感兴趣
lines.en: What is not sweet does not interest it.
Its feet clasp the fruit's edge.

lines.zh: 它被你的手指推了一下
lines.en: Your finger nudges it aside.
It lifts off and lands again.
It folds its wings tight over itself.
Having fed, it crawls away.
It leaves a little wing dust behind.
The moth suddenly flies at you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的果香，翅膀快了。
lines.en: I smell fruit on you, and my wings beat faster.
Its wings open wider than before.

lines.zh: 它落在你的手背上不走
lines.en: It lands on your hand and stays.

lines.zh: 它开始往你的袖口里钻
lines.en: It starts crawling into your cuff.
Its proboscis unrolls.
It is hunting for something to feed on.

lines.zh: 它的触角敲着你的皮肤
lines.en: Its antennae tap your skin.
It hovers right before your eyes.

lines.zh: 翅膀扑出的风扫到你脸上
lines.en: The downdraft of its wings reaches your face.
The moth keeps circling you.
It lands on your shoulder, then lifts.
It goes for the gaps in your clothing.

lines.zh: 它在你后颈处停了一下
lines.en: It pauses at the nape of your neck.

lines.zh: 它在找一个不受打扰的位置
lines.en: It is looking for an undisturbed spot.
You swat; it slips aside.
And comes straight back.

lines.zh: 它的翅在你耳边响得很近
lines.en: Its wings sound very close to your ear.
It clings inside your collar.

lines.zh: 它在袖子里慢慢往上爬
lines.en: It climbs slowly up your sleeve.

lines.zh: 蠹蛾把口器刺进你的皮肤
lines.en: The moth drives its proboscis into your skin.
It gives a tiny nip.

lines.zh: 它的翅粉糊在你眼睛边
lines.en: Wing dust smears by your eye.
It flutters wildly around your head.
It strikes your face and rebounds.
It crawls back out of your cuff.
It settles at your neck.
Its feet grip your collar.
It pricks once and flies off.
It circles back to try again.
A grey shape flits through the night.
The moth settles on the trunk.

lines.zh: 它的翅纹和树皮混在一起
lines.en: Its pattern blends with the bark.
It spreads its wings and basks.
Its antennae move first.
It flies half around the tree.
A lamp stretches its shadow.

lines.zh: 它停在一片有虫洞的叶上
lines.en: It settles on a leaf with a hole in it.
It shivers and dust falls.
It starts a low, slow circuit.

lines.zh: 翅被火一燎就卷了，它直落
lines.en: A lick of flame curls its wing; it drops.

lines.zh: 落地时它的翅折了一半
lines.en: It hits the ground with half a wing folded.
Wet wings will not carry it.

lines.zh: 冲击把它扇得无影无踪
lines.en: The blast sweeps it out of sight.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膜，留下一个洞
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through its wing.
Odd force spins it in place.
Starved, it can barely fly.

lines.zh: 电光一闪，它被烧得蜷起
lines.en: A flash and it curls, scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走空气，它越飞越低
lines.en: The void takes the air; it sinks lower.
